test_title: PYST 20: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 10th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

I decided to / sang a song / in the interschool / song competition.
solution:
The correct answer is **'sang a song', i.e. the error lies in this part of the sentence.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error lies in the incorrect usage of the **infinitive.**
